coverage_assessment: Completed an open-web first pass for April 2025 using Portuguese and English, country/month and event-specific searches, local/regional and international result discovery, student and worker/strike terms, and contemporaneous/retrospective follow-up. One executed April 26 MEA student gathering in Luanda is retained as proposed_include based on an opened report explicitly stating >50 members were gathering; the number is attributed, not an exact maximum, and remains for independent review. A second opened report describes detentions and alleged police assaults; RTP is an advance notice only. No facts were coded from search excerpts or held pages. Residual gaps cover independent crowd-size confirmation, completed route/end, state-response detail, source independence, access restrictions and unsearched/inaccessible archives; searches do not establish absence or reproduce LexisNexis. Historical start time and native tool clocks remain unknown where not actually observed.
